description_en: Obtain the hotline monitoring status metrics by skill group dimension. Supports queries grouped by instance, time range, department, and skill group
description_zh: 获取热线下监控技能组纬度状态量。支持实例、时间区间、部门、技能组分组查询
kebab_example: aliyun aiccs get-skill-group-latitude-state --instance-id ccc_xp_pre-cn-000 --start-date 1615083365000 --end-date 1617761765000 --page-size 20 --current-page 1 --dep-ids 100 --group-ids 123 --exist-department-grouping true --exist-skill-group-grouping true --api-version 2019-10-15 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetSkillGroupLatitudeState

parameters.help_en:
AICCS instance ID.  
You can obtain it from Instance Management in the left-side navigation pane of the Artificial Intelligence Cloud Call Service console (https://aiccs.console.aliyun.com/overview)
parameters.help_zh:
AICCS实例ID。
您可以在智能联络中心控制台 (https://aiccs.console.aliyun.com/overview)左侧导航栏的实例管理中获取

parameters.help_en: The start date as a UNIX timestamp. Unit: milliseconds
parameters.help_zh: 开始日期时间戳。单位：毫秒

parameters.help_zh: 结束日期时间戳。单位：毫秒

parameters.help_en: The page size. The value must be greater than 0. Default value: 20

parameters.help_en: Current page. The value must be greater than 0. Default value: 1

parameters.help_en: A list of skill group IDs
